name: Gods Judgement
overview: God's judgment is a solemn reality where every person will give an account of their words and actions, as Jesus teaches that even idle words will be judged (Matthew 12:36) and all must stand before God individually (Romans 14:12). While God did not send His Son to condemn the world but to offer salvation (John 3:17), those who reject Christ are already under condemnation (John 3:18). Judgment follows death as an appointed event (Hebrews 9:27), and self-righteous judgment is condemned since judging others often reveals our own guilt (Romans 2:1). This calls believers to humility and faith in Christ as the only means of escaping condemnation.
